depiction_rules.notes: New, chapter-specific juvenile group required by D046 stanza 2 (bālakaiḥ / arbhakāḥ). Do not use the adult gopas community contract for these children.

visual_bible.age: young cowherd boys, children close to Krishna’s age
visual_bible.face: distinct child faces with ordinary human features and varied expressions
visual_bible.skin: warm medium-brown Indian skin, clearly brown rather than orange
visual_bible.hair: simple dark natural hairstyles, varied among the boys
visual_bible.build: ordinary child proportions with natural two-arm and two-leg anatomy
visual_bible.clothing: complete modest village clothing: simple muted dhotis with short wraps or shawls in cream, olive or maroon
visual_bible.continuity_markers: a small non-duplicated group of distinct young companions, visually secondary to Krishna and Yashoda
